metadata.description: AI recipes for people who run a company's finances: prompts and skills checked on sample files with answer keys

plugins.name: orla-finance-ai-recipes
plugins.description: Finance recipes as skills: who owes us, bills due, cash forecast, month close, bank requests and more. Each works on a file you attach, in any model, and on live books when the Orla plugin is connected. No skill here moves money.
